senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (जवति)
1 To go or move.
2 To move quickly, to go rapidly.
(ङ) जुङ् r. 1st cl. (जवते)
To go or move.

f. (-जूः)
1 Æther, heaven.
2 A name of the goddess SARASVATĪ.
3 A female demon or goblin.
4 Speed, expedition, velocity.
5 Going, motion.
E.
जु to go swiftly, affix क्विप्, and the final lengthened.
